**PTN000123605**
LKRSDH (Drosophila, Q9VLX0)
AASS (human, Q9UDR5) and probably all the ortholgos

**PTN000259224**
eap (Drosophila, Q8SXB3)
AASDHPPT (human Q9NRN7)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous propagation
L-lysine is an essential aa for Drosophila and mammals so there is no L-lysine biosynthetic process for these species.
If I am not mistaken only the fungi LKRSDH homolog protein is able to do the reverse reaction leading to L-lysine biosynthesis.
title: PTN000123605 lysine biosynthetic process via aminoadipic acid

author: marcfeuermann
body: You are right, I corrected both cases.
